title: My favourite teacher
instructions: Ahmet en sevdiği öğretmenini anlatıyor. Neden sevdiğine dikkat et.

script.speaker: s
script.text: My favourite teacher was Mr Davis. He taught me history when I was fourteen.

script.speaker: s
script.text: Before his lessons, I thought history was boring.

script.speaker: s
script.text: But he told stories and showed us old photos and films.

script.speaker: s
script.text: He also took us on trips to museums and castles.

script.speaker: s
script.text: Because of him, I studied history at university.
